data.one_liner: Google Places autocomplete TextField for Android, iOS, web, desktop.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TextField that queries the Google Places API and displays suggestions. It can return place details including latitude and longitude, and supports custom list item builders.
use_when: You need address input with autocomplete
You need to retrieve coordinates from a place
You want a customizable list item UI
avoid_when: You already have a custom autocomplete implementation
You don't want to depend on Google Places API
strengths: Null safety and modern Dart syntax
Customizable debounce, country filtering, keyboard type
weaknesses: Requires a Google API key and network access
Limited to Google Places API features
No built‑in error handling beyond basic callbacks
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, provide a valid Google API key, no special permissions needed.
